bio.text: Ed Markey is the U.S. Senator for Massachusetts, elected in a special election in June 2013 after 37 years in the U.S. House of Representatives.
He was born in Malden, Massachusetts, in 1946 and attended Boston College and Boston College Law School.
In the House he chaired or was ranking member of the Subcommittee on Telecommunications and the Internet for 20 years and was Dean of the Massachusetts delegation.
